Then, without hesitation in the eyes of Asuna and the others, she whispers to Kirito. "I hope you think of me whenever you unsheathe your sword." says Sinon with a wink and smile on her face.

## character.sinon_alo_2022_yukata

Have you ever thought about how weird the light is that fireflies give off? It's not too bright by any means, yet it just grabs your attention. That's why I'll always remember this night... Not that it has anything to do with you. I'm talking about fireflies, remember?

## character.sinon_alo_idol

I can't believe I'll be walking out in this garb... Not to mention that he'll be out there in the seats as well. What is he going to say about this after the show...? I'm going to be embarrassed up there so he'll probably poke fun at me regardless. So my only option is to just get up on that stage and enjoy it for what it's worth.

## character.sinon_alo_pajamas

Is the Holy Sword pronounced Excalibur? Or Exalibur? Sinon wondered. The thought made her reminiscence times with Kirito and the excitement that would come from his many late night stories. Pulling one of those same stories from the bookshelf and laying on her bed, she begins to fall asleep as she fondly remembers her time in ALO.

## character.sinon_alo_swim

Passing through a massive tube of waves, Sinon's bullet could just about slice through the skies. Thinking of the trajectory the bullet should pass through in the condensation the bullet creates, Sinon felt flustered as she realized how much she was thinking about a bullet.

## character.sinon_ggo

Together with her favorite gun (Hecate II), she is a well known sniper in GGO. Tormented by the ominous memories of an incident from her youth, she harbors an innate fear of guns. However, since the "Death Gun Incident", she has gradually overcome this trauma. Without turning her back on guilt, she stares ahead, marveling at Kirito's strength, and resolves to confront both herself and her past.

## character.sinon_ggo_2nd_anniv

Sinon in an outfit to celebrate our 2-year anniversary. It's been a long run, hasn't it? Can't wait for what else is coming!

## character.sinon_ggo_recollection

Gun Gale Online, which Sinon is a regular, is a VRFPS style MMORPG where players can shoot each other with real guns. Sinon joined the game in order to get stronger and overcome her own trauma towards guns, but it quickly became an irreplaceable reality for her. Wanting to continue getting stronger, she grips on to favorite gun, Hecate II.

## character.sinon_os

Sinon and the others enjoyed their time on Ordinal Scale. Asuna, however, lost to the SAO boss monster and lost all of her memories. "I'm not a survivor of SAO, so it's ok" Sinon says as she helps out the lone fighter, Kirito. "In return, at least let me ride your motorcycle on the way back, ok?"

## character.sinon_solus

At 3AM, Asada Shino's phone begins to vibrate from an incoming call. Looking at her phone, the screen shows that it is a call from the unconcious Kirigaya Kazuto. "Hurry! Mama and Papa are in danger!" says the caller. It was Kirito and Asuna's "daughter", Yui. Shino then hops onto a taxi heading towards the Roppongi branch of Rath.

## character.sinon_solus_al

Sinon was agitated as she encountered Subtilizer. Vivid memories of her experiences in BoB flashed in her head as her consciousness laid in limbo. Resisting these dark thoughts, Sinon uses her memories and imagination to transform her Solus bow into her Hecate II, her favorite. She bolts back into action and peers through the scope of her one companion. "I won't lose... Not with you by my side, Hecate!"

## character.sinon_solus_enhance

Using the Sun God Solus account, Sinon descends into Underworld. Raining light arrows from the skies at the surrounded Human Empire army and Asuna, she destroys her enemies with her overwhelming display of power. "I can't rapid fire" Sinon realizes as she calmly analyzes the situation above ground. While she is overjoyed at meeting Asuna again, Sinon flies in the air to follow the trail of the kidnapped Asuna.

## character.sinon_solus_place

Receiving a message from Yui at 3 am, who was monitoring the situation in Underworld, Shino logs in with the 2nd Rath super account, as the Sun Goddess Solus in order to help out Asuna and the others. In the midst of large numbers of enemies surrounding the Human Empire's army, Sinon descends from the glowing heavens and annihilates the enemies with her divine weapon, the Annihilate Ray.

## character.sinon_ur

Sinon watched the dust sweep through the dry earth around her. It's a sight that she had seen countless times on GGO, but this time she found herself in uncharted territory. Observing her surroundings with a careful eye, she pondered her next course of action. Though she had her doubts regarding the equipment she had with her, it was better than nothing. Still, her beloved gun remained behind in storage, leaving Sinon feel lost without it. Casting away these feelings, Sinon runs off into the wastelands to assess her situation.

## character.siune_alo

An ALO player. She plays an Undine, and is a member of the Sleeping Knights guild. She always maintains a calm composure, and as her team's only mage, is responsible for supporting and healing the other members. Together with Yuuki and the rest of her guild, she has traveled through countless VRMMO worlds in order to find the most exciting one so that they can leave their mark on it and create unforgettable memories for themselves.

## character.sortiliena_army_empire

Sortiliena prepares to join the frontlines. Ever since she was a child, Sortiliena honed her sword skills for this one moment. But what her training never prepared her for was what it meant to put one's life on the line. Conflicted on whether she is ready for the fight ahead, she focuses on her training to calm her nerves...

## character.sortiliena_child

Sortiliena Serlut during her childhood years in Underworld. Within the Norlangarth Empire which recognizes High-Norkian Style as the official sword technique, she's part of a minority who adopted the Serlut Style. Because of that, she was treated as a heretic by those around her. It wasn't until she encountered the Zephyria flower that her life took a major change.

## character.sortiliena_swimsuit

Today was the day that Sortiliena went to go visit the springs in the suburbs. Arriving at her destination, the chirping of birds and an assortment of colorful flowers awaited her. She wondered how long it's been since she was able to relax and forget her troubles like this. Clear skies, a beautiful scenery—and the person next to her, made her feel content with what lay ahead.

## character.sortiliena_trainee2nd

An Elite Disciple at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. She has been the Second-Seat Elite Disciple since enrollment. Although equally matched with Volo—the First-Seat—in terms of skill, she is not confident in her ability to block his powerful skills, and has never beaten him in combat. She comes from a family that was banned from using the official High-Norkian style and instead practices a constantly changing practical combat style known as "Serlut Style." She chooses Kirito, who uses a similar sword style to her own, as her page.

## character.sortiliena_valentine

At the Winter Solstice Festival, Kirito gave Sortiliena the origin of the festival - the nut of a special tree. Will Kirito find delicious tea for Sortiliena, just as he promised on that day?  As Sortiliena bakes a walnut pie for Kirito, her cheeks lay back to the thought of him running about looking for tea.

## character.subtilizer

The thief. The seeker. The taker. Only the essence of souls interest him. He only emotions he understands are the fear and despair one feels just before death. He wonders, how will the boy with the black hair's fear taste when I bring him within inches of his life? He feels a great thirst spring up inside of him. "Your feelings, your memories, your heart, your soul--I will devour every last drop."

## character.sylvie_dark_knight_skirt

Today was the first time I stopped seeing those dreams. In those dreams, my parents were gone, nowhere to be found. I was alone, yet no matter how hard I looked, there was no way to get them back. The only thing I have is this sword, this sword that took away my parents. This sword is my only family now.

## character.tiese_child

While on the way home from her excursions in the forests of the Swordcraft Academy, Novice trainee Tiese remembered the person who had a curiosity in golden flying foxes, Eugeo. "I said they weren't rare, but... speaking of which, I remember when I was a kid that me and my father found a golden flying fox in the hills..." Struck by the sudden recollection, Tiese's face beamed with joy as Ronie, who is walking besides her, looks at her suspiciously.

## character.tiese_contest

Shall we dance? my question was met with eyes that peered back at as if my words had lost their way to their rightful owner. "Time to have a little fun then!", I thought. I grabbed his hand before he could utter a response and lead him to the middle of the room. He was still shocked. Which, I found hilarious, so I laughed. And with a giggle, he finally figured out who he was dancing with. And so I smiled a little more, and I held on even tighter.

## character.tiese_halloween

It's the night of the Harvest Festival. Putting on an outfit that she had prepared specifically for this day, Tiese leaves her dorm room and heads towards the stairs leading to the entrance. As she begins to descend down the stairs, she gets surprised as the students at the bottom of the stairs begin to direct their attention towards her. "Something must be off...I'll guess I'll have Ronie take a look later" Tiese thinks to herself as she nervously exited the dorms at a brisk pace. Soon after, rumors begin to circulate as to the identity of this mysterious beauty.

## character.tiese_mc_bath

It's the best place in the entire Cathedral. At least, that's what the older knights preached. One dip in these waters and all your worries of the day go melting away is what they said. The bathes at the academy were big, but even those were nothing compared to the gargantuan size of the Great Bath. I wonder if Shimosaki would be happy if I brought her along to swim? Then again...the heat might just make her dizzy. "Frost" is in her name after all.

## character.tiese_mc_plate

Tiese become an Integrity Knight apprentice. Recalling the lessons that Eugeo had given her, she spends her days practicing her sword swing. A void had opened within her heart from the loss of that special person, and she feared that sooner or later memories of that person may become a distant memory. Though she has these thoughts, perhaps it's inexperience that make her feel this way? Focusing her body and soul, she continues to work towards becoming a powerful swordsman.

## character.tiese_swimsuit

Wanting to impress Kirito and the others just even for a little bit, Tiese dons a swimsuit and spends some time with the others playing at the lake. Arriving before the beautiful lake, she could no longer contain her excitement and dived straight into the waters even with her brand new hat on.

## character.tiese_trainee1st

A Novice Trainee at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. She comes from a low-ranking noble family, and is Eugeo's page. She was brought up believing that nobles must do their utmost to ensure the peace and happiness of all the people. As a result, even though he's a high-ranking noble, she refuses to accept Humbert's despicable acts towards her friend Frenica, and goes to confront him together with Ronie.

## character.tiese_trainee1st_date

I invited him without really thinking about it, but... Tiese laments as she thinks over the invite from the other day. "What does he think of me? He doesn't think that I'm improper, does he?" Tiese continues thinking over these as she headed towards their meeting spot. But those same worries evaporated as the person she worried so much about extended out his hand sweetly. The perfect day was just about to start.

## character.tiese_trainee1st_ketsui

It's going to be dusty, so I'll open the window. Tiese says to Eugeo, immersed in his book, while she continues cleaning in her role as a page. Though the Schtrinen family is made up of nobles, there are no barriers. Even the nonchalant Eugeo has found a place within the family. As she continues her services as a page to the strange yet kind Eugeo, Tiese's feelings blossom into something special.

## character.tiese_valentine

The Winter Solstice Festival - the time when girls give gifts to the person they feel affectionate for and confess their feelings. Because this event only happens once a year, this day is a very special day. For this day only, girls - regardless of status, position, or even their appearance - want to entertain the one they love the most! Preparing extra delicious sweets, Tiese's heart waits for the one she exchanged promises with.

## character.volo_trainee2nd

An Elite Disciple at Norlangarth Imperial Swordcraft Academy in Underworld. His position as First-Seat Elite Disciple is unchallenged. He bears the family name of a line of traditional instructors in the Sword Arts of the Imperial Knight Order, which carries with it a secret "family rule," and is a skilled user of the official High-Norkian Style. His swings are so powerful that, using a wooden sword, he shatters the log used for training. He demands that Kirito duel with him with real swords as punishment for splashing mud on his uniform.

## character.yui_alo_aprilfool

All my life, I've dreamed of fighting alongside Mommy and Daddy. That day has finally come. No longer can I sit back and watch from the sides. With this sword, I will protect you! Mommy, Daddy! Here I come!

## character.yui_sao

Wandering the forests with no memories, Yui was saved by Kirito and Asuns, whereupon the three began living like a family. However, while looking for her real parents in the Town of Beginnings, she got caught up in trouble and ran into the Blackiron Palace dungeon. It was there that the dangerous boss, The Fatal Scythe, lay waiting. Cornered, the girl with no memories slowly crept forward towards the enemy.

## character.yui_sao_2021_sep

Today is Mommy and Daddy's wedding anniversary. So that's why it's just the three of us here today. It was originally just going to be Mommy and Daddy celebrating, but in the end they wanted me to tag along... Daddy is nice and all, but sometimes I think it's alright to be a little pushy and bring Mommy along.

## character.yuna_4th_os

He could faintly hear a familiar singing voice. Even among the throngs of people that filled streets of the town, he could still hear it. Looking closely at the figure sitting on the rail overhead, she was just as he imagined. Her mischievous eyes met his. "Oops. Looks like you found me; let's keep it a secret between you and me."

## character.yuna_os

The AR device Augma shows people the idol Yuna in action. During her sudden rise in popularity, she even had plans to do a live performance at the New National Stadium. She passed herself off as an AI, but hidden on the other side of all this excitement lies a huge secret related to the SAO incident.

## character.yuriko_alo

This is so COOL! I'm in a fantasy world... but in real time! These wings on my back also let me fly through the skies at will... Just like a wind warrior! If I hear anyone crying for help, I will answer the call wherever they may be. Sounds just like what a protagonist in a story would say, right?

## character.yuuki_alo

An ALO player. Known as "The Absolute Sword," she is an extraordinary swordswoman who created an astonishing 11-hit Original Sword Skill. As a last memory for the members of her soon-to-be-disbanded guild, the Sleeping Knights, she wants to defeat a Floor Boss and have the names of all the members engraved on the Monument of Swordsmen. She takes a liking to Asuna after crossing swords with her in a street duel, and asks her for assistance.

## character.yuuki_alo_2022_swim

Nothing beats the sea! Or... Maybe I feel this way because... You're here? Hey, I have an idea! How about doing some volleyball next time? We came all the way here after all, so let's go all out!

## character.yuuki_alo_al

A gentle breeze blew through the blue skies. Sunlight twinkled through the trees as a crystal clear voice crept in between. "Let's fly!" Without hesitation, she stretched out her hand towards the hand in front of her. She knew she was in safe hands, as the smile in front of her guided her.

## character.yuuki_alo_al_wou

Yuuki slowly closed her eyes as she laid down on the sofa, the sunlight enveloping her like a blanket. She was seconds from slumber when she heard gentle, deliberate footsteps coming from the kitchen. It was Asuna. The soft aroma of freshly steeped tea began to fill the room. With her finger twirling a lock of hair, Asuna playfully asked, "Still up?". Yuuki refused to respond. This peace, the calm in her heart, this feeling she was experiencing was rare for her. Just one moment longer, please.

## character.yuuki_alo_anniv

Yuuki in her 2.5-year anniversary outfit. "Thank you for always being there by my side. It's thanks to you that I've made it this far. Here's to more memories together."

## character.yuuki_alo_aprilfool

I'm just a regular ol' adventurer, not one of those hero types. But that doesn't mean that I can just sit back and watch the Demon King destroy the world around me. That and I can't let him getting away with the last attack bonus in the world! If I'm the only one who can pick up the mantle of hero, then I will fight with all my might!

## character.yuuki_alo_init

An ALO player. She plays a young Imp girl who leads the Sleeping Knights guild. An extremely fast one-handed sword user, she has fought over 60 street duels and not yet lost a single one. When she defeated Kirito, he said, "If she'd been a SAO player, it would have been her who received the Dual Blades skill." Her extraordinary power has earned her the alias "The Absolute Sword."

## character.yuuki_alo_piece

Nicknamed the "The Absolute Sword" in ALO for her overwhelming speed and strength, Yuuki leads members of her guild, the Sleeping Knights, to take down the Floor Boss in the reborn Aincrad. Their plan was to have their names engraved on the Monument of Swordsman located in the Town of Beginnings. Welcoming Asuna into her guild as a supporter, the two stiffen their resolve in conquering the Floor Boss.

## character.yuuki_halloween

Decorated with jack-o'-lanterns and candy in an assortment of colors, for one day only, the town's tavern was rented out to hold a Halloween party. The guild sponsoring this party was the "Sleeping Knights". Asuna and the others, who received an invitation, opened the doors of the tavern, where Yuuki appeared dressed in a cute dress with a cake decorated for this special day. "There you are! We've been waiting for you!" Yuuki exclaims with a smile as she welcomed them in.

## character.zink_soldier

The head guard of Rulid Village in Underworld. He inherited this Calling from his father, and claims to be the most powerful swordsman in the village. According to village law, he is able to enter the Zakkaria Swordsmanship Tournament in four years time, and he takes objection to Eugeo attempting to join the Zakkaria Garrison before he does. In order to prove that he is the more skilled swordsman, he challenges Eugeo to a duel.

## season_point_boost.001

A special perk that doubles (+100%) your season points and event points obtained.

## tips_loading.2

The “Timeline” at the top of the screen will show you your turns in battle. Know your enemy’s moves and strategize your attacks!

## tips_loading.3

You can activate Sword Skills in battle by using MP. Sword Skills deal larger damage than regular attacks, as well as activate other effects.

## tips_loading.4

Charge your Incarnation to 100% and deal major damage  with an Incarnate Skill! When an enemy is hit with an Incarnate Skill, it triggers "Knockback" and delays their next move!

## tips_loading.5

If an Incarnate Skill is activated when another ally’s turn comes before an enemy’s, “Combination Skill” activates. During a Switch Combination, Sword Skills can be used without using MP, and at the very end unleash “Final Attack” for additional damage.

## tips_loading.6

Incarnation can be charged by using any Charge Skill!  Take advantage of these skills to charge your Incarnation!

## tips_loading.7

Enemies can also activate Incarnate Skills. Try to lower their Incarnation charge before they use it to decrease incoming damage! Cut their charge to 0% to stop them from activating it!

## tips_loading.8

“Incarnate Break” will activate when an enemy’s Incarnation charge drops to 0%. When this happens, the enemy will be unable to use their Incarnate skill and their next turn will be delayed!

## tips_loading.9

Break skills are a faster way to lower an enemy’s Incarnation charge! Use a Break skill to weaken an enemy’s Incarnate skill!

## tips_loading.10

Assault Skills deal larger damage than other skills.

## tips_loading.11

A Skill Link occurs when Assault, Break,  and Charge Skills are used in succession, triggering an effect bonus!

## tips_loading.12

Tap and hold a character on the Party screen,  then tap "Enhance" to level up a character.  Try leveling up your characters above the quest's "Enemy Lv." when you run into a tough enemy!

## tips_loading.13

Each character has a Skill Slots that increase stats or activate special effects.  If you can’t defeat an enemy,  try collecting items to release your character’s Skill Slot!
